rules: Freeze source plan and exact prompt before each image_gen call.
16 complete newly drawn independent poses in four rows and four columns: arrival, preparation, attack, recovery.
Transparent background, complete weapon/body within each isolated cell, default facing right.
No manual painting, recolour, alpha repair, pose synthesis or mirror counted new; only original RGBA extraction, nearest scaling and packing.
All tool results, prompts, raw files, exclusions and visual reviews retained.
Official original frames and 1:1 source certification are not claimed.
